meta.name: review-testing
meta.description: Review test code for quality, design, and completeness after implementing a feature or fixing a bug. Use when the user asks to "review my tests", "check my test quality", "are these tests good enough", "review testing", or after completing a feature implementation that includes tests. Also use when tests feel brittle, flaky, or superficial. Cross-references production code to find coverage gaps.

copy.tagline: 审查测试代码的质量、设计和覆盖率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚写完功能或修复 bug，想确认测试是否足够好。
